In this file the effective sample size distributions atr explored for models based on the GUSTO data set.

```{r}
library(Hmisc)
library(rms)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
getHdata(gusto)
gusto.dat <- gusto
```

Subset of data used
```{r}
#Create a subset of the data with centers from US region and one non-US region
gusto.dat <- gusto[which(gusto$grpl %in% c(1,2,4) & gusto$grps %in% c(5,9,10,11)),] 
n_pat <- nrow(gusto.dat) 
gusto.dat$pat.id <- 1:n_pat #new variable patient id
#summary(gusto.dat)


colSums(is.na(gusto.dat))
```

Model with one predictor: age
```{r}
## goal: Calculate effective sample sizes
X_ols_age <- model.matrix(~age, data=gusto.dat)  # predictor age matrix 
XTX <- t(X_ols_age)%*%X_ols_age  

n_eff_OLS_A <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_age)) #computes the effective sample size
for(i in 1:length(n_eff_OLS_A)){
  A <- solve(XTX)%*%X_ols_age[i,]
  n_eff_OLS_A[i] <- 1/(t(X_ols_age[i,])%*%A)      
} 
neff_all <- data.frame(pat.id = (1:nrow(X_ols_age)),form="form0", n_eff_OLS_A = n_eff_OLS_A)   


```

Min and Max of age effective sample size distribution:
```{r}
range(neff_all$n_eff_OLS_A)  
```

Visualization: Effective Sample Size vs Age:
```{r}
neff_all$age <- gusto.dat$age 

ggplot( neff_all , mapping = aes(x= age, y= n_eff_OLS_A, colour = n_eff_OLS_A)) +
  geom_point( alpha= 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colours=rainbow(3)) +
  labs(
    title = "Effective n* for age OLS predictor",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Effective n*",
    colour = "Effective n*"
  )
```

Model with one predictor: height
```{r}
X_ols_height <- model.matrix(~height, data=gusto.dat)  #predictor height matrix
XTX <- t(X_ols_height)%*%X_ols_height

n_eff_OLS_H <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_height)) #computes the effective sample size
for(i in 1:length(n_eff_OLS_H)){
  A <- solve(XTX)%*%X_ols_height[i,]
  n_eff_OLS_H[i] <- 1/(t(X_ols_height[i,])%*%A)      
} 

neff_all$n_eff_OLS_H <- n_eff_OLS_H
neff_all$height <- gusto.dat$height

summary(n_eff_OLS_H)
```

Visualization: Effective Sample Size vs Height:
```{r}
ggplot( neff_all , mapping = aes(x= height, y= n_eff_OLS_H, colour = n_eff_OLS_H)) +
  geom_point( alpha= 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colours=rainbow(3)) +
  labs(title = "Effective n for height OLS predictor") +
  ylab( "Effective n ")
```

Min and Max of height  effective sample size distribution:
```{r}
range(neff_all$n_eff_OLS_H)
```

Model with two predictors: age + height
```{r}

X_ols <- model.matrix(~age+height, data=gusto.dat)   #predictor matrix |age + height|
XTX <- t(X_ols)%*%X_ols

n_eff_OLS <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols)) #compute the effective sample size
for(i in 1:length(n_eff_OLS)){
  A <- solve(XTX)%*%X_ols[i,]
  n_eff_OLS[i] <- 1/(t(X_ols[i,])%*%A)
}
summary(n_eff_OLS)
```

Visualization : Age and Height observations colored by their effective sample size
```{r}
neff_all$n_eff_OLS <- n_eff_OLS
neff_all$age <- gusto.dat$age
neff_all$height <- gusto.dat$height

ggplot(neff_all, aes(x=age, y=height, color=n_eff_OLS, fill=n_eff_OLS))+ 
       geom_point(alpha=0.8)+
       scale_fill_gradientn(colours=rainbow(3))+
       scale_color_gradientn(colours=rainbow(3))+
       theme_bw()+
       labs(fill = "Effective n*", color="Effective n*", title = "Effective n* for age and height OLS predictors") +
       xlab("Age in years")+
       ylab("Height in cm")

```

Measures:

Subjects with effective sample size > 1200 in 1D (one predictor) vs 2D age and  height:

AGE 
```{r}
range(neff_all$age[n_eff_OLS_A>1200])
range(neff_all$age[n_eff_OLS >1200])
```

HEIGHT 
```{r}
range(neff_all$height[n_eff_OLS_H>1200])
range(neff_all$height[n_eff_OLS>1200])
```

```{r}
mean(neff_all$n_eff_OLS_A > 1200) * 100
mean(neff_all$n_eff_OLS_H > 1200) * 100
```

Model with two continuous correlated predictors weight and height
```{r}
#weight and height corr= 55%

X_ols_cor <- model.matrix(~weight+height, data=gusto.dat)
XTX <- t(X_ols_cor)%*%X_ols_cor

n_eff_OLS_cor <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_cor))
for(i in 1:length(n_eff_OLS_cor)){
  A <- solve(XTX)%*%X_ols_cor[i,]
  n_eff_OLS_cor[i] <- 1/(t(X_ols_cor[i,])%*%A)
}

#Visualization:
neff_all$n_eff_OLS_cor <- n_eff_OLS_cor
neff_all$weight <- gusto.dat$weight

ggplot(neff_all, aes(x=weight, y=height, color=n_eff_OLS_cor, fill=n_eff_OLS_cor))+ 
       geom_point(alpha=0.8)+
       scale_fill_gradientn(colours=rainbow(3))+
       scale_color_gradientn(colours=rainbow(3))+
       theme_bw()+
       labs(fill = "Effective n", color="Effective n", title = "EFF. SAMPLE SIZE OLS for weight and height") +
       xlab("weight")+
       ylab("Height")

```

Model with one continuous predictor (age) and one binary predictor (sex)
```{r}
X_ols_bin <- model.matrix(~sex+age, data=gusto.dat)
XTX <- t(X_ols_bin)%*%X_ols_bin

n_eff_OLS_bin <- numeric(length = nrow(X_ols_bin)) #effective sample size
for(i in 1:length(n_eff_OLS_bin)){
  A <- solve(XTX)%*%X_ols_bin[i,]
  n_eff_OLS_bin[i] <- 1/(t(X_ols_bin[i,])%*%A)
}

neff_all$sex <- gusto.dat$sex
neff_all$age <- gusto.dat$age
neff_all$n_eff_OLS_bin <- n_eff_OLS_bin
summary(n_eff_OLS_bin)
```



Model with 7 predictors "f7" and model with 15 predictors "f15" 
```{r}
gusto.dat$SBP_trunc <- pmin(gusto.dat$sysbp, 120)

f7 <- model.matrix( ~ tx + age + Killip + SBP_trunc + lsp(pulse, 50) + pmi + miloc, data=gusto.dat)


f15 <- model.matrix( ~ tx + age + Killip + SBP_trunc + lsp(pulse, 50) + pmi + miloc + rms::rcs(height, 6) + smk + dia + weight + prevcabg + htn + prevcvd + ttr +age*Killip , data=gusto.dat)
```

effective sample size of model "f7"
```{r}
XTX <- t(f7)%*%f7

n_eff_OLS_f7 <- numeric(length = nrow(f7))
for(i in 1:length(n_eff_OLS_f7)){
  A <- solve(XTX)%*%f7[i,]
  n_eff_OLS_f7[i] <- 1/(t(f7[i,])%*%A)       
} 

neff_all$n_eff_OLS_f7 <- n_eff_OLS_f7

```

effective sample size of model "f15"
```{r}
XTX <- t(f15)%*%f15

n_eff_OLS_f15 <- numeric(length = nrow(f15))
for(i in 1:length(n_eff_OLS_f15)){
  A <- solve(XTX)%*%f15[i,]
  n_eff_OLS_f15[i] <- 1/(t(f15[i,])%*%A)       
} 

neff_all$n_eff_OLS_f15 <- n_eff_OLS_f15
```

Visualization:

effective sample size density per model
```{r}

neff_long <- neff_all %>%
  select(n_eff_OLS_f15,
         n_eff_OLS_f7,
         n_eff_OLS_A,
         n_eff_OLS,
         n_eff_OLS_bin) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "modello",
               values_to = "ESS")  %>%
  mutate(modello = factor(modello,
                          levels = c("n_eff_OLS_A",
                                     "n_eff_OLS_H",
                                     "n_eff_OLS_bin",
                                     "n_eff_OLS_f7",
                                     "n_eff_OLS_f15")))

```

Visualization effective sample size density per model
```{r}

ggplot(neff_long, aes(x = ESS, color = modello)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(x = "Effective Sample Size",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_color_discrete(name= "",labels = c("Age",
                                  "Age + Height",
                                  "Age + Sex",
                                  "Model with 7 predictors",
                                  "Model with 15 predictors")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
  axis.line = element_line(),
  axis.ticks = element_line()) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.95, 0.95),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top")
  )



```
